title: ChatAnalysisOutput
description: Classpath copy of docs/schemas/chat_analysis_v1.schema.json for JUnit tests. KEEP IN SYNC with the canonical file under docs/schemas/. The schema test (ChatAnalysisOutputSchemaTest) asserts every primitive property carries a description, so missing descriptions here fail CI.

topic.description: Dominant subject the user is talking about. NOT a clinical label.

emotion.description: Dominant emotional tone observed. DISTRESS is safety-relevant.

intent.description: What the user appears to want from the chat. NOT a final action decision.

signals.description: Behaviour-level tags attached to the message.

modelRiskLevel.description: Model's own risk signal (1=normal, 2=follow-up, 3=high risk, 4=emergency). NOT the final risk level.

textHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the substring.

evidenceSpans.description: Pointers into the input message (offset + SHA-256 hash). NEVER raw substring.

latencyMs.description: Wall-clock time the provider spent producing the result, in milliseconds.

errorCode.description: Stable code for partial / failed outputs. null for success.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version of this record. Always V1.
